== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
<tabber>
General Trivia=
===General Trivia===
* Nicknamed "'''Korean Slayer'''" by the Brazilian community, for achieving high numbers of solokills against Korean toplaners.<ref>[https://twitter.com/maisesportsbr/status/1619442902203240448 Mais Esports' Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* Has a non-official pentakill in '''[[CBOLÃO/Season 5|CBOLÃO Season 5]]''' as {{ci|Kennen}}.
* In [[Vivo Keyd Stars]], [[SeeEl]] once referred to him as his "franchise player".
|-|
Non-League-related Trivia=
=== Non-League-related Trivia ===
* Is the younger brother of [[Vitin]].
* He once dated [[Mayumi]].
** His NA soloqueue nickname after going to Canada to play in the [[MSI 2025|MSI]] is a homage to him.
* His transfer from [[Vivo Keyd Stars|VKS]] to [[FURIA]] is rumoured to be one of the most expensive signings in Brazil.<ref>[https://x.com/coachseeel/status/1871497414546501886 SeeEl's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* He is often made fun of for his short height.
* His family is very supportive of him, especially his father.<ref>[https://ge.globo.com/esports/lol/noticia/circuito-desafiante-pai-de-guigo-emociona-em-video-de-comemoracao.ghtml Circuito Desafiante: pai de Guigo emociona em vídeo de comemoração (Portuguese)] ''ge.globo.com''</ref>
* He once said in a interview that his biggest idol in life is [[wikipedia:en:Gordon Ramsay|Gordon Ramsay]], but in the competitive scene he is inspired by [[Zeus]]. He is also a big fan of [[BrokenBlade]].
|-|
Notable Achievements=
=== Notable Achievements ===
* Reached Finals in regional tournaments (CBLOL and LTA South) with three different teams: [[RED Canids]] (2021.2 and 2022.1), [[Vivo Keyd Stars]] (2024.2) and [[FURIA]] (2025.2).
* Was featured in '''LoL Esports Plays of the Week''' with his {{ci|K'Sante}} outplay against [[Isurus Estral]] during the [[LTA South 2025 Split 1]] as the '''Top 5 Play'''.<ref>[https://x.com/lolesports/status/1884591988273455271 LoL Esports' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
|-|
Awards=
=== Individual Awards ===
* 1x LTA South Finals MVP (2025.2)
|-|
